adapters_needed.reason: BancConnectome carries int32 synapse counts and no transmitter vocabulary; SynapseModel expects a per-neuron sign array and transmitter metadata
BrainSimulator is bound to SynapseModel, whose constructor fails on BancConnectome; a separate loop must own the BANC edge arrays, current state and delay buffers
excitatory and inhibitory edge arrays must be built once per policy so unknown-sign edges can be excluded without changing the graph artifact
every result must carry graph threshold, policy, seed and decoder configuration explicitly

risks: Structural synapse counts are not conductances; any weight scale is a modelling assumption, not a physiological estimate.
Presynaptic transmitter identity does not fix the postsynaptic effect; signs are modelling priors.
Recurrent excitation without calibrated inhibition can produce an avalanche; the simulator must cap spikes and check finite state.
The full t1 graph has 11.6M edges; naive dense operations would exceed memory, so only sparse CSR gathers are allowed.
A propagated decoder label would still be a computational output, not evidence of biological motor control.
